research_question: Across the same spatial anchors, how much C0 certainty is gained by shrinking parent-cell depth versus micro-refining the same parent, and at what exact range-evaluation cost?

optimizations: prepare field weights once in float64
single refinement tree reused for micro depth 0/1/2
no repeated parent evaluation for separate micro settings

primary_outputs: state fractions by stratum x depth x micro
decisive fraction by stratum x depth x micro
paired per-anchor state transitions across depth
interpretation_rules: Any empirical sign contradiction against PROVEN_EMPTY is an implementation alarm and blocks C1.
Near-zero stratum is for stress characterization and may not be used as a proof source.
If certainty improves primarily with parent depth, spatial refinement is the dominant control.
If certainty improves primarily with micro depth at fixed parent depth, local range tightening is the dominant control.
If neither depth nor micro materially reduces UNKNOWN, C0 range machinery remains practically insufficient.
A successful C0 result authorizes only review of C1 regularity research, never product promotion or extractor promotion.
